notes: d2-d4 yes: 'the legs'. d7 yes: repetitive leg movements with no net movement, not called walking. d8 no: 'no net movement of the fly'. d5/d6 unclear: the legs were 'held at awkward angles', with no direction given. d9 yes: 'grooming attempts'. d11 yes: rare wing movements, usually grooming-associated. 24B is absent from Figure 9A, so takeoff and buzzing were not reported as categories (not_assessed). The source's driver information conflicts: the text and Supplementary file 1 name R15A03, but the Video 22 legend (PDF p. 23 and XML) says 'TRPA1 under control of R22G11' (the 1A driver). The Supplementary file 1 'Behav' row for 24B ends in 'LexAop>STOP>GFP', not TRPA1, which is probably a typo. Figure 7 legend labels the panels 'Hemilineage 24', and the section text once says 'Hemilineage 24A (Brown and Truman, 2009; lineage B of Baek and Mann, 2009)'. I used the section heading and Figure 7 panel label '24B'.
